boards.title: Your First Weekend at Franklin and Marshall College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence that starts on campus, makes room for connection and study, then introduces Lancaster’s arts, parks, market, games, and theatre.

cards.title: Start at the campus front door
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Lombardo Welcome Center
cards.notes: Use the interactive campus map from the Welcome Center page to orient yourself, pick a next stop, and take a first unhurried walk across campus.
cards.short_summary: A practical first landmark for learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M identifies the Lombardo Welcome Center as its host location for College tours and links to an interactive campus map with wayfinding.
cards.access_notes: The College lists the center at 933 Harrisburg Ave.; confirm any tour availability before going.

cards.title: Find a calm campus base
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Shadek-Fackenthal Library
cards.notes: Walk through the main library, locate the Info Desk and SparkLab, and choose a comfortable spot to review the week or plan tomorrow’s outing.
cards.short_summary: A first look at F&M’s humanities, social-sciences, and fine-arts library.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M says Shadek-Fackenthal Library holds humanities, social sciences, and fine-arts print collections and includes the Info Desk, SparkLab, and learning spaces.
cards.access_notes: Library services and access can vary; check the library before planning an extended visit.

cards.title: Locate your science-side resources
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Martin Library of the Sciences
cards.notes: If your classes touch the sciences, stop in to identify the Tech Lending Center, ITS Help Desk, and Archives & Special Collections for later use.
cards.short_summary: A useful resource stop for science, technology, and archival support.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M states that Martin Library of the Sciences holds science print collections and houses Archives & Special Collections, the ITS Help Desk, and Tech Lending Center.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current desk and collection access with the library.

cards.title: Choose one thing to try
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Student Engagement & Leadership
cards.notes: Browse the club options, save one or two groups that genuinely interest you, and watch for their next open meeting or introductory event.
cards.short_summary: A simple way to turn a first-weekend interest into a campus connection.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M says its Office of Student Engagement & Leadership creates, promotes, and supports opportunities for students to become connected, empowered, and engaged.
cards.access_notes: The College reports 110 clubs and organizations; participation details depend on each organization.

cards.title: Make time for a gallery visit
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday • Phillips Museum of Art, Steinman College Center
cards.notes: Check the exhibition information, then spend a focused half hour with a few works rather than trying to see everything in one visit.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus art stop with regularly scheduled exhibition access.
cards.evidence_claim: A current F&M Phillips Museum event identifies the museum in Steinman College Center, lists regular Tuesday–Sunday hours, and marks the exhibition event free.
cards.source_title: Phillips Museum of Art Reopens for Fall Semester!
cards.access_notes: The cited F&M event lists regular hours as noon–4 p.m., Tuesday through Sunday; verify exhibitions and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Take a park reset nearby
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Buchanan Park, 901 Buchanan Ave.
cards.notes: Bring water, take a daylight loop through the park, and use the pause to compare notes with a new friend before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: A named Lancaster City park beside F&M’s neighborhood.
cards.evidence_claim: Lancaster City lists Buchanan Park at 901 Buchanan Ave. among its public parks and spaces.
cards.access_notes: Use public park areas and observe posted rules; special events and pavilion use require permits.

cards.title: Browse the Saturday market
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning or early afternoon • 23 N. Market St.
cards.notes: Walk one complete circuit before buying anything, notice the range of vendors, and choose a snack or ingredient only if it fits your budget.
cards.short_summary: A downtown public market stop for a self-paced Lancaster introduction.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lancaster describes Lancaster Central Market as a year-round market open Tuesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m.
cards.source_title: Lancaster Central Market | City of Lancaster, PA
cards.access_notes: The City lists Tuesday, Friday, and Saturday hours of 6 a.m.–3 p.m.; vendor offerings and availability vary.

cards.title: Add a free local-art stop
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Lancaster Museum of Art
cards.notes: Check what is on view, then use the visit as a relaxed conversation starter—choose one piece each and share what caught your attention.
cards.short_summary: A downtown museum visit with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Lancaster Museum of Art states that admission is free and lists museum hours on its visitor information page.
cards.source_title: Lancaster Museum of Art Contact Information
cards.access_notes: The museum’s visitor page lists Tuesday–Saturday, Sunday, and First Friday hours; verify the current schedule before traveling.

cards.title: Play a round together
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Decades, downtown Lancaster
cards.notes: Make this a small-group activity: agree on a game or bowling round, set a spending limit beforehand, and keep the focus on friendly play.
cards.short_summary: A documented downtown option for bowling and classic arcade games.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M’s Lancaster activities guide recommends Decades for bowling and classic arcade games.
cards.source_title: Visiting F&M? Explore Winter Activities On and Off Campus
cards.access_notes: Games and bowling may require payment and availability; check directly with the venue before visiting.

cards.title: Close with a show plan
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon or evening • Fulton Theatre, 12 N. Prince St.
cards.notes: Look over the current calendar with friends, select a performance that works for everyone, and purchase tickets only after confirming the date and access needs.
cards.short_summary: A downtown regional-theatre option with a current ticket calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fulton Theatre’s current ticket page lists mainstage, family, studio, and concert series performances and directs visitors to ticket and pricing information.
cards.access_notes: Performance dates, start times, ticket availability, and accessibility options vary; verify the selected performance before going.
